title: justicia elegantissima
intro: Justicia elegantissima, commonly known as Queen of the Night, is a flowering plant species native to Central America and Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, boasting health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions, while also exhibiting antiviral and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Justicia elegantissima include its ability to calm the nervous system, alleviate stress and anxiety, and promote a restful night's sleep. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a sought-after ingredient in herbal remedies.
